positions.title: Game Developer
positions.focus: Game programming, gameplay mechanics, and implementation.
positions.responsibilities: Develop and maintain game features; optimize performance; fix bugs; collaborate with design.
positions.requirements: Experience with Unity or Unreal Engine, C# or C++, and game-development fundamentals.

positions.title: Game Designer
positions.focus: Gameplay systems, mechanics, and player experience.
positions.responsibilities: Design mechanics, progression systems, levels, balancing, and engaging player experiences.
positions.requirements: Understanding of game-design principles, documentation, balancing, and player behavior.

positions.title: 2D/3D Artist
positions.focus: Game art, characters, environments, and visual assets.
positions.responsibilities: Create characters, environments, objects, textures, animations, and other game assets.
positions.requirements: Experience with Blender, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar creative tools.

positions.title: Game UI/UX Designer
positions.responsibilities: Design menus, HUDs, interfaces, navigation, icons, and user flows for mobile and PC games.
positions.requirements: Experience with Figma or similar design software and an understanding of usability and game interfaces.

positions.title: Game QA Tester
positions.focus: Game testing, quality assurance, and bug identification.
positions.responsibilities: Test gameplay; identify and document bugs; verify fixes; help ensure stable releases.
positions.requirements: Strong attention to detail, testing skills, and an understanding of gaming platforms.

positions.title: Game Marketing & Community Manager
positions.focus: Game promotion, player acquisition, and community growth.
positions.responsibilities: Manage social media, Discord communities, marketing campaigns, influencers, events, and player engagement.
positions.requirements: Experience with digital marketing, social media, community management, or the gaming industry.
